scripts.start: docker compose up -d api queue-worker scheduler frontend nginx db redis
scripts.dev: docker compose up api queue-worker scheduler frontend nginx db redis
scripts.artisan: docker compose exec api php artisan
scripts.tinker: docker compose exec api php artisan tinker
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec api php artisan migrate
scripts.migrate:fresh: docker compose exec api php artisan migrate:fresh --seed
scripts.migrate:status: docker compose exec api php artisan migrate:status
scripts.seed: docker compose exec api php artisan db:seed
scripts.storybook:build: docker compose exec frontend npm run build-storybook
scripts.lint: docker compose exec frontend npm run lint
scripts.lint:fix: docker compose exec frontend npm run lint:fix
scripts.format: docker compose exec frontend npm run format
scripts.test:api: docker compose exec api php artisan test
scripts.test:frontend: docker compose exec frontend npm run test
scripts.queue:restart: docker compose exec api php artisan queue:restart
